summary: Comprehensive Health and Integrity in Licensing and Documentation Act of 2026 or the CHILD Act of 2026 This bill restores the authority for businesses and organizations that provide care or care placement services for children, the elderly, or individuals with disabilities (care-providing businesses and organizations) to request national criminal history background checks for contractors and for individuals they certify or license. Federal law authorizes care-providing businesses and organizations to request national criminal history background checks for certain covered individuals .  A 2018 law narrowed the scope of  covered individuals to two categories: (1) current or prospective employees or volunteers, and (2) current or prospective owners or operators.
